summary: Full end-to-end backend + frontend testing of AiraVolt AI. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests pass (auth, security, analysis, dashboard, simulate, reports, favourites, notifications, contact, chat SSE, bill scan validation, data isolation, admin RBAC). Frontend: all public pages render with correct data-testids; signup mismatch error works; signup success + auto-login + redirect to /analysis works; wrong-password login shows login-error; correct login lands on /dashboard; all 7 protected routes redirect to /login when logged out; energy analysis form submits, shows aira-loader, redirects to /dashboard with live values (efficiency 60/100, waste 26.9%, savings $109.23/mo derived from submitted inputs); all dashboard charts + top-consumers + historical-comparison render; recommendations page shows Gemini summary + 6 cards, all 5 filter buttons present and filtering works (quick -> 1 card), fav-btn stars items; report page renders all 4 action buttons (regenerate/email/download/print) and regenerate + email work; simulator sliders drive all 9 output tiles live (bill saving $229.47/mo etc) and reset returns them to $0; chat streams via SSE (chat-thinking observed, chat-message-assistant produced), quick chips + mic + voice toggle present; notification bell opens panel with 6 items and unread badge; profile has all 5 tabs, request-verification, verified-badge, logout works, settings save works; forgot-password UI flow issues reset-token-value and reset-password-input, resets password, and new password logs in successfully; logout clears session and protected route redirect resumes.

issues: Horizontal scrollbar / overflow of ~74px on mobile viewport (documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth = 74). /analysis and /contact have 0 overflow, only Landing hero causes overflow.

action_items: Landing page: fix ~74px horizontal overflow at 390px mobile viewport (likely an oversized hero element or absolute-positioned glow escaping the viewport). Recommend adding overflow-x:hidden on the hero section or constraining the animated background.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1163 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth.py, analysis.py, chat.py, reports.py, contact.py) for maintainability.

CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers actually reject this combination for cookie auth; luckily frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage so it works, but the wildcard+credentials combination is misleading. Recommend explicit origin from env.
reset_password does NOT invalidate open reset tokens for the same user (only marks the used one). Minor: consider deleting all outstanding tokens for that user_id after a successful reset.

Report reference sequence uses db.reports.count_documents({}) + 93041 as an auto-increment, which is not race-safe under concurrency. Consider a MongoDB counters collection with findOneAndUpdate $inc.
notify() writes without checking user's settings.notifications preference — user toggling notifications off in settings still receives them.
bill/scan tempfile is unlinked in finally, good. But if os.unlink raises (rare), it'd mask the real error. Acceptable.

success_rate.frontend: ~98% (all critical flows pass; 1 mobile overflow design issue on Landing)

test_credentials: Admin unchanged: admin@airavolt.ai / AiraVolt@2026. Test signup users created dynamically with unique timestamped emails; no cleanup required (documents prefixed TEST_ where applicable).
seed_data_creation: None beyond throwaway signup users and one TEST_John contact enquiry (used by admin-only listing test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, 32 tests, ~30s). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All auth flows (login/register/forgot-reset/verify-email/logout/profile-update), analysis + dashboard + simulate, reports (create/list/get/email), favourites, notifications, contact (public POST + admin GET), chat SSE, bill scan negative, security/RBAC + data isolation are covered. Frontend Playwright scripts confirmed every data-testid listed in the review request exists and works. The only real defect is the ~74px horizontal overflow on Landing at 390px width — everything else in the spec is implemented and functional.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Design issue on Landing mobile likely caused by an oversized decorative element or negative-margin background exceeding viewport width; can be confirmed by inspecting hero section and applying overflow-x:hidden on the outer wrapper.
